reason: I already put the same amount into index funds every month and don't look at it, so I don't need an agent to invest or rebalance for me. Paying another monthly subscription to automate something that's already automatic doesn't make sense.
objection: My broker already has free AI tools and auto-invest. I don't see why I'd pay extra, at a price nobody has even set yet, to hand my money to a Tamagotchi pet run by a company that doesn't have a real-money broker partner yet.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran at a known licensed broker and cost less than what I'd pay a robo-adviser, while doing something my free broker tools can't, like handling my bills and investing in one place without me checking on it.
